steps.title: Load negative urine samples
steps.instruction: Load the 96‑well plate with negative urine samples according to the layout (blank in A1, calibrators in A2‑A8).

steps.title: Configure pipettes
steps.instruction: Set the protocol parameters: Number of Samples = 1‑96; P300 mount = left or right as required; P1000 mount = left or right as required; aspiration height = 1 mm from the bottom of the well.

steps.title: Add enzyme to all wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 60 µL of Enzyme into every well of the 96‑well plate (column‑wise transfer).

steps.title: Add buffer to all wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 340 µL of Buffer into every well of the 96‑well plate (column‑wise transfer).

steps.title: Add blank urine to A1
steps.instruction: Dispense 300 µL of Negative Urine into well A1 (blank).

steps.title: Add calibrator urine to A2‑A8
steps.instruction: Dispense 270 µL of Negative Urine into wells A2 through A8 (calibrators).

steps.title: Add spike INSTD to all wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 20 µL of Spike INSTD into every well of the plate (column‑wise transfer).

steps.title: Add water to all wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 30 µL of Water into every well of the plate (column‑wise transfer).

steps.title: Incubate after water addition
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for 30 minutes after the water has been added.

steps.title: Add methanol to all wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 700 µL of Methanol into every well of the plate (column‑wise transfer).
